title: An agent can set, read and change a layer's keys
goal: Ask and outside agents have no way to key a layer, so nothing they make can move. Give them the same keys a person sets on the timeline, so animation work can start now without waiting for a better balloon.
notes: Split out of ask-animates-what-it-makes-an-animated-svg-icon so its wait on the balloon holds only what needs a good icon. The 2026-11-05 digest raised this: the tools for keying layers do not need a good balloon, only animation's last try does. That wait stays exactly as intake set it. Files: AgentTools.swift, AskPlanning.swift, LayerMotion, MotionProperty, KeyMoments.swift, PropertyKeys.swift, SVGMotionExport. Use the keys the video editor uses, since animating-a-picture-is-as-simple-as-setting-a-mo is designing one shared way of keying; if that design changes the model, the tools follow it. No code for a particular subject or animation (Hard rules in queue/bin/runner-prompt.md). Nothing here teaches Ask when to animate: that stays in the task it came from.
acceptance: New agent tools, offered to Ask and over MCP, set keys on a layer's property with times, values and easing, and make a picture timed with a length and a loop; each call is one undo step and schema checked like every tool
read_document shows a layer's keys, and keys set by a tool appear on the timeline where a person can pick and change them
An icon keyed through the tools exports as an animated SVG that loops and plays the same in Photonz's own timeline
The agent coverage check counts the new tools, and the skill's reference lists them

Try path: through the MCP tools on the probe, key a shape's rotation, play it, Copy SVG. Audit written under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not
